2. Baker lifts a croissant from the tray on the workbench behind the counter.
3. Baker slips the croissant into a paper bag on the counter.
keyframes.state: The baked croissant is inside the open paper bag on the counter, with baker’s hand at the bag’s opening. The tray on the workbench holds only the six unbaked croissants.

keyframes.source: 4. Baker passes the bag across the counter to neighbour on the left.
keyframes.state: Neighbour, on the left, holds the paper bag containing the baked croissant; baker no longer holds it.

keyframes.source: 5. Baker lifts the loaf from the cooling rack.
keyframes.state: Baker holds the single unwrapped loaf. No loaf remains on the cooling rack.

keyframes.source: 6. Baker folds paper around the loaf on the counter.
keyframes.state: The loaf rests on the counter inside the folded cream wrapping paper, with baker’s hands against the paper.

keyframes.source: 7. Parent receives the wrapped loaf from baker on the right.
keyframes.state: Parent, on the right, holds the paper-wrapped loaf. Baker’s hands are empty.

keyframes.source: 8. Baker’s shoulders droop beneath the apron straps.
keyframes.state: Baker’s shoulders are drooped beneath the apron straps.

keyframes.source:
9. Neighbour smiles at baker.
10. Parent smiles at baker over the wrapped loaf.
keyframes.state: Neighbour smiles at baker while holding the paper bag. Parent smiles at baker over the wrapped loaf in their hands.

keyframes.source: 11. Baker lifts their head, eyes opening wider as a smile spreads across their face.
keyframes.state: Baker’s head is upright, their eyes wider and their face smiling.

first: Fixed eye-height, wide diagonal view from the rear customer-side corner of a modest working bakery toward its front wall: cream plaster, honey-coloured timber, worn stone flooring and dark metal baking equipment, all clean but comfortably used. The blue glazed front door is far left, with its shop-name sign mounted at adult chest height; the large clear front window is far right. The wooden counter occupies middle left and runs from near to far. Baker stands behind it, on its right-hand working side, wearing the apron with its straps and thin patches and specks of flour. Across the counter on the customer side, neighbour stands to the left, parent to the right, and child beside parent. The wooden workbench is far right with its working edge toward the camera; the flour bowl rests at its far-right end. A single charcoal-grey pastry tray rests on the workbench, holding six pale, unbaked croissants and the separate honey-gold baked croissant intended for neighbour. The oven is middle right against the right wall, and the wire cooling rack is near right against that wall, holding one broad oval, honey-gold loaf with three diagonal marks. One empty, open brown paper bag stands on the counter, and one flat sheet of cream loaf-wrapping paper rests beside it. All four characters are present across the counter from one another.
